setlist.title: Beat It on Down the Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (1 review): The performance is very nice, with a 'Here Comes Sunshine' theme in the transition [23]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Wonderful jamming includes a great transition to the last chorus [23]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The performance is perfect, with Phil doing a great job [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-06-09.131169.mtx.fix.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 209 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd73-06-09.sbd.hollister.172.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 202 min; rated 4.41/5 by 31 [2]. Said about its sound: The soundboard recording features good sound quality and a nice mix; The soundboard is considered great for the era with all elements present [14][16]
- **gd1973-06-09.sbd.barry.patched-172.93677.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 205 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [5]
- **gd1973-06-09.sonytc.monte-barry.91236.flac16**: source not stated; 26 songs; 190 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [9]
- **gd73-06-09.partial.aud.weiner.gdADT25.22790.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 10 songs; 63 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [11]. Said about its sound: The audience recording has a distant sound, suggesting the taping position was far back [17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the date coincides with the 42nd anniversary of JFK's assassination [20]
- It was sunny and hot, easily over 100 degrees, with Dead playing first on Saturday [5]
- Allman Brothers Band played first on Sunday, following the Grateful Dead's Saturday show [5]
- Taped from FOB center infield, between the SBD platform and stage platform [9]
- Reviewer describes this as the most 'out there' Grateful Dead show they experienced [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-06-09.131169.mtx.fix.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: Fix of 2 Source Matrix (130939) by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:000172) S:MR > cassette > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN > TLH > flac; Extraction and SHN encoding by G.S.… [1]. Also: This is a fixed version of the previous matrix file, updated after new computer installation [1]
- **gd73-06-09.sbd.hollister.172.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Most tracks follow a lineage from SBD MR to cassette, DAT, CD, EAC, SHN; Promised Land, Half Step, and Sugar Magnolia use a different source lineage [2]
- **gd1973-06-09.sbd.barry.patched-172.93677.shnf**: transferred by Monte Barry; source: SBD > Master Reel [5]. Also: Monte Barry patched Sugar Magnolia using his audience source to complete the finale [5]
- **gd1973-06-09.sonytc.monte-barry.91236.flac16**: taped by Monte-Barry; transferred by Monte-Barry; source: Sony TC 110 cassette deck [9]
- **gd73-06-09.partial.aud.weiner.gdADT25.22790.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Adam Grow; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 10, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/june-10-1973) [25]
